content.comment_body: I'm new to [product_name] and was wondering if there is a straightforward way to toggle an output on a weekly schedule? I have a setup where I want one output to stay on for an entire week, starting Monday at 12:00am and turning off at the end of Sunday, 11:59:59pm. Essentially, I want to alternate the output weekly (one week on, one week off, etc.). Any advice would be very helpful.

Hello, You can achieve this using a weekly timer in combination with edge detection and a pulse relay. Set the desired start time on Monday and stop time on Sunday; using positive edge detection, you can control the pulse relay output accordingly. See the attached illustration for reference. Regards, [user_name]
That's exactly what I needed! Thanks for the guidance.
